subject.title: message_tool_only: one-shot delivery reminder loses to recency over long tool chains, turns end in withheld finals

question: For `message_tool_only` turns that go many tool calls deep and end with a plain final, should OpenClaw add periodic in-turn delivery reminders, bounded withheld-final recovery, or both?
rationale: The source proves the warning-only withhold path and one-shot directive, but the durable fix changes prompt traffic, duplicate-delivery risk, retry behavior, and the privacy contract for suppressed finals.

options.title: Combine Reminder And Recovery
options.body: Add a compact fixed-size reminder after bounded tool activity and a one-shot recovery path for substantive private finals, coordinated with the open recovery PR or its successor.

options.title: Recovery First
options.body: Refresh and review the open recovery PR or an equivalent branch to convert silent loss into a retry or sanitized diagnostic, leaving periodic reminder work separate.

options.title: Reminder Only
options.body: Refresh the delivery instruction during long turns while keeping withhold behavior warning-only until a later recovery decision.

recommendation.title: Combine Reminder And Recovery
recommendation.body: Add a compact fixed-size reminder after bounded tool activity and a one-shot recovery path for substantive private finals, coordinated with the open recovery PR or its successor.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available owner signal for a cross-cutting privacy, prompt, and source-delivery product decision.
